FINRA disseminates inter-dealer trades on the sell side only, so the split is not a measure of investor buying versus selling. TRACE caps reported size at $5MM+ for investment-grade bonds; capped trades are counted at the cap, so all volumes are minimums. Counts reflect the tape&rsquo;s current state: cancelled trades are excluded, and corrected trades are counted once, at their corrected values.</p>
